source_title: Marvix AI Partners with Unlimited Systems to Bring Smarter Clinical Documentation AI to Specialty Practices
source_excerpt:
Partnership pairs Marvix AI's specialty-focused clinical documentation with Unlimited Systems' revenue cycle expertise, giving specialty practices a connected path from the exam room to the claim.
CINCINNATI , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Marvix AI , a full-stack clinical documentation AI for specialty care, today announced a partnership with Unlimited Systems , a leading provider of revenue cycle management and medical billing software for specialty practices. Through the partnership, Unlimited Systems customers will now have the option to access Marvix AI's specialty-focused AI scribe, pre-charting, and post-visit modules.
The partnership brings together two critical parts of the specialty practice workflow: clinical documentation at the point of care and the revenue cycle work that follows. Marvix AI covers the entire clinical visit. It creates pre-visit summaries and patient recaps from prior reports, provides ambient scribing, and generates custom notes for unique clinical scenarios. It also recommends ICD-10-CM, E/M, CPT, and HCC codes against the latest guidelines, flags care gaps, and lets providers query patient records through AI agents. Marvix AI integrates two-way with EHRs across more than 23 specialties, including neurology, oncology, orthopedics, and ophthalmology. Unlimited Systems brings deep expertise in medical billing, RCM, and payer workflows. Together, the two companies give specialty practices a more connected way to capture the right clinical detail upfront and carry it through to coding, billing, and payer workflows.
"This partnership reflects our shared belief that better documentation shouldn't just save physicians time - it should strengthen the entire revenue cycle," said Rashie Jain, Co-founder & CEO, Marvix AI. "Specialty practices lose time and revenue when documentation and billing operate as separate, disconnected steps, especially given the complexity of specialty workflows. By partnering with Unlimited Systems, we're closing that gap, so the clinical detail captured at the point of care makes coding and billing more efficient downstream, and practices get paid accurately for the care they deliver."
"Delivering a joint solution with Marvix AI extends our commitment to helping specialty practices close the gap between exceptional clinical care and strong financial performance," said Brian Gockerman, CEO of Unlimited Systems. "One of the most consistent sources of lost revenue we see across specialty practices is undercoded documentation, where complex, high-acuity care never makes it into the chart with the specificity needed for accurate E&M level assignment. Marvix AI addresses that directly at the point of care, and Unlimited Systems carries that clinical intelligence through every step of the revenue cycle. Together, we help practices get paid for the full value of the care they deliver."
Marvix AI and Unlimited Systems are helping specialty practices improve provider productivity while strengthening revenue integrity - ensuring accurate documentation at the point of care that supports coding, reimbursement, and payer readiness from day one.
Marvix AI is redefining clinical documentation for specialty care with AI built for complex medical workflows. It supports the entire clinical visit: pre-charting, where it creates Patient Recaps that synthesize prior notes, labs, imaging, and clinical history; AI scribing for note generation during patient encounters; and post-visit coding, including ICD-10-CM, E/M, and HCC codes with rationale based on clinical guidelines. It integrates directly with leading EHRs, enabling two-way data flow to pull prior visit data and push notes into EHR template sections. Marvix is trained across 135 specialties and sub-specialties, so documentation reflects each specialist's voice and clinical reasoning. Marvix AI helps specialists complete end-to-end documentation more efficiently, reducing administrative burden and saving providers 2 to 3 hours of administrative work every day.
Unlimited Systems provides specialty healthcare organizations with technology and services that drive peak financial performance. Its secure cloud platform supports AI-enabled medical billing, revenue cycle management, patient engagement, workflow automation, and payer-specific optimization. With deep specialty expertise spanning oncology, neurology, ophthalmology, rheumatology, and beyond, Unlimited Systems helps practices achieve what matters most: collecting more of what they earn. In best-practice environments, Unlimited Systems customers achieve net collection rates exceeding 98% - outcomes made possible through touchless RCM workflows that reduce manual staff intervention at every stage of the revenue cycle, from eligibility and prior authorization through coding, claim submission, and denial resolution.
